name: github-watch
description: Watch GitHub repos for new issues and releases — github connector + watcher mini-app with a 15-min check job and github.new_event events.
env_example: # Optional but strongly recommended: without a token you get 60
# requests/hour per repo. Use a fine-grained token, Contents+Issues
# read-only. Leave empty only for very light public-repo watching.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 004_github_watch.sql, hot-loads the app).
Watch a repo: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/github-watch/repos -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"repo": "agent-boom/agentboom-sdk"}'
Checks run every 15 minutes (manifest job); new issues/releases publish github.new_event.
Set GITHUB_TOKEN in .env for anything beyond casual use (60 req/h unauthenticated).
